newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ITE to raise S$9.7 mln by warrant issue.
newsitem.headline: ITE to raise S$9.7 mln by warrant issue.

text.p: ITE Electric Co Ltd (ITE) said on Wednesday it planned to issue 12 million warrants to raise a total of Singapore $9.7 million.
ITE said in a statement the warrants would be for 12 million new ordinary shares of Singapore $0.20 each in the company.
The warrants would be issued in conjunction with a three-year S$10 million revolving credit facility, ITE said.

ITE said it would use about S$8.25 million of the proceeds to redevelop its business premises and would use the balance of about S$1.5 million to refinance bank borrowings and to use as working capital.
The facility and the issue, both subject to approvals from shareholders and the Stock Exchange of Singapore, would be handled by NDC Merchant Bank Ltd.
The warrants would be issued on the basis of three warrants for every 10 existing ordinary shares to shareholders with registered addresses in Singapore.

Sia Teck Mong and Henry Knaggs, who in aggregate hold about 12.1 million shares or about 30 percent of the ITE issued capital, had agreed to buy or secure buyers for 3.6 million shares, the statement said.
